name: hopper
title: Hopper
description: Jump to any app, tab, or agent: step back and forward through recent apps like browser history, search everything open across apps, and jump to the AI agents that need you (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, herdr).
author: matt_herwig

commands.name: back
commands.title: Back
commands.subtitle: Hopper
commands.description: Switch to the app you used before this one, like a browser's Back button. Run again to keep going back. Best bound to a hotkey.

commands.name: forward
commands.title: Forward
commands.subtitle: Hopper
commands.description: Undo a Back step. Best bound to a hotkey.

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle
commands.subtitle: Hopper
commands.description: Flip between your two most recent apps. Run again to flip back. Best bound to a hotkey.

commands.name: history
commands.title: History
commands.subtitle: Hopper
commands.description: List running apps from most to least recently used and switch to any of them.

commands.name: tabs
commands.title: Search
commands.subtitle: Hopper
commands.description: Search everything open on your Mac and jump to it: browser tabs, terminal tabs and panes, herdr workspaces, Claude and Muse sessions, Notion tabs, any app's windows, and AI agents with their status.

commands.name: app-tabs
commands.title: Search Current App
commands.subtitle: Hopper
commands.description: Search the tabs, windows, sessions, and agents of the app you're in and jump to one.

commands.name: agents
commands.title: Agents
commands.subtitle: Hopper
commands.description: List the AI agents running on this Mac (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, herdr, agent CLIs) by status, most urgent first, and jump to where one runs.

commands.name: next-agent
commands.title: Next Agent
commands.subtitle: Hopper
commands.description: Jump to the agent that has waited longest for you: one that needs input first, then one that finished. Run again for the next. Best bound to a hotkey.

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
